relations.rationale: Cleo being taller than Kira and shorter than Otto together imply a height ordering, but 13 alone doesn't establish Cleo's relation to Otto, so it neither confirms nor denies 14.
Height comparisons have no bearing on the physical state of sorted waste piles.
Height comparison between Cleo and Kira has no bearing on who is oldest among the group.
Height ordering has no bearing on finishing order in some activity.
Cleo's height relative to Otto has no bearing on Esme's age.
Height comparison between Cleo and Otto has no bearing on who is oldest.
Cleo wandering the tide line noting trash is a separate event from Esme finding a flip-flop; they can coexist but neither implies the other.
Cleo noting overnight trash accumulation describes the beach before cleanup, which is consistent with and supports the later observation that the beach looked cleaner by midday after cleanup efforts.
Otto finishing ahead of Kira and Kira finishing ahead of Esme are compatible orderings that together support a consistent ranking, so 16 supports the plausibility of 19.
Finishing order has no bearing on age.
Otto's finishing position relative to Kira has no bearing on Esme finding a flip-flop.
Otto finishing ahead of Kira is consistent with and supports the separate claim that Otto finished ahead of Esme, as both indicate Otto's strong performance.
Otto's finishing position relative to Kira has no bearing on Leo photographing results.
Sorting items into bins is a separate event from Esme finding a flip-flop; no direct causal link.
The group sorting collected trash directly supports the observation that the beach looked cleaner by midday.
Sorting items into recycling bins and trash bags directly supports the existence of neat piles of sorted waste along the boardwalk.
Kira finishing ahead of Esme is consistent with and supports Otto finishing ahead of Esme, since both suggest Esme finished later.
Finishing order has no bearing on who is oldest.
Esme's age has no bearing on the state of sorted waste piles.
Esme being youngest is consistent with and supports Leo being the oldest, as both describe compatible positions in an age ranking.
